🚨 **SARAH HUCKABEE SANDERS JUST GOT MAGA MAD AT HER OWN WELFARE AD.**

Arkansas Gov. Sarah Huckabee Sanders released a new campaign ad promoting her state's **welfare-to-work requirement**. Then say the quiet part out loud! The ad introduces a fictional character named **“Brad”** — a young white man lounging in a beanbag chair, eating junk food and playing video games — before Sanders argues that able-bodied people receiving government assistance should work, attend school or volunteer.

But then something unexpected happened.

**MAGA commentators started attacking the ad.**

Conservative voices including Matt Walsh, Jack Posobiec and others criticized Sanders for portraying a **white man** as the face of welfare abuse. Some argued that the demographic depiction was misleading or unfair, while others accused the ad of insulting one of the Republican Party's core constituencies.

And that's where this story gets REALLY interesting.

Because Sanders' policy isn't what triggered the biggest backlash.

**It was who she chose to portray.**
